integrity: The finite computation follows a separate geometric exhaustion of negative curves. Two exact independent enumerations agree; the generalized geometric input is proved by adjunction and standard Shioda–Tate lattice arguments.
scientific_limitations: Over the complex numbers for the blowup of the nine distinct Hesse-pencil base points; counts negative-support chambers, not volumes or symmetry orbits. Historical priority is provisional and no independent scientific audit has occurred.
title: The Zariski-chamber polynomial of the Hesse rational elliptic surface
